course_name_original: Creación de Empresas de Base Tecnológica
prerequisites: It is preferable to have successfully completed the first-year common course 'Empresa'.
It is preferable to have successfully completed several technology-related courses directly linked to the future exercise of their profession.

learning_outcomes.text: Integrate and provide a commercial vision to the knowledge acquired in other technological courses.
Put into practice interpersonal skills related to teamwork (leadership, communication, group management, negotiation...) in any professional activity.
Interact with real external agents (suppliers, clients, financial entities...) and understand the organizations and support instruments for entrepreneurs.
Promote an entrepreneurial spirit in any professional activity.
Put into practice business communication techniques.

syllabus_topics: Generalities: objectives, methodology and work plan of the course.
The process of creating a technological micro-company: market study and business plan.
Environment to study, study approach and instruments.
Income statement (or profit and loss) and cash flow (or receipts and payments) budgets.

assessment_methods.method: Final exam: final presentation of the group project (EXA_FIN)

assessment_rules: For the ordinary examination, the final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA x 0.5 + EXA_FIN x 0.3 + PA x 0.2, provided a minimum attendance of 75% is met. If this formula yields at least 5 points, the course is passed. Failure to meet the minimum attendance results in a 'No Presentado' grade. For extraordinary examinations, the final grade is calculated as: NOTA FINAL = PLAN_EMPRESA_EXTRA x 0.6 + EXA_EXTRA x 0.4. If this formula yields at least 5 points, the course is passed. Students must notify the professor at least 4 weeks in advance for extraordinary examinations and submit the final business plan at least 48 hours before the exam.
